summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan to restructure Game N high scores and First To Complete (FTC) system:
1. Startup 3-letter initials code prompt with Firestore uniqueness checks and gear icon in Global High Scores to edit the code.
2. Order tabs: Story, Arcade, Speed run, Survival.
3. Replace filler scores with beatable AAA-JJJ defaults (99:99.9 for lowest time, 00:00.1 for longest time), and remove all score/points fields.
4. Update Story leaderboards to track stage completed without time/score, with compact '⚡FTC: ???' banner.
5. Update Arcade leaderboards to track stage completed, duration, and Total HZ, ranking by stage then duration, with compact '⚡FTC: ???' banner.
6. Update Speed run leaderboards to label (fastest) and remove stage/score.
7. Update Survival leaderboards to add Total HZ and remove stage/score.
